title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Designs, builds, and maintains large-scale data pipelines and infrastructure. Works with distributed systems and cloud platforms.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Builds and maintains data pipelines under senior guidance. Writes SQL and Python scripts for data transformation.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Deploys machine learning models into production. Bridges gap between data science and software engineering.

title: Data Scientist
description: Builds predictive models and derives insights from large datasets. Uses statistical methods and machine learning.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description: Designs and implements server-side application logic, APIs, and databases.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Develops both frontend and backend components of web applications.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automates infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and maintains platform reliability.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Architects and manages cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Transforms raw data into clean, well-documented datasets for analysts and data scientists using dbt and SQL.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyzes data to provide business insights. Creates dashboards and reports.

title: AI Engineer
description: Builds AI-powered applications and integrations using LLMs, RAG, and agent frameworks.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Builds internal developer platforms that improve engineering productivity and reliability.

title: Data Architect
description: Designs enterprise-scale data architecture, governance frameworks, and technology strategy for data platforms.

title: Research Engineer / Applied Scientist
description: Conducts applied ML research and translates research findings into production systems.

title: Security Engineer
description: Designs and implements security controls, performs threat modeling, and responds to incidents.
